content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Appeared in Madhyamik or equivalent examination; Candidates who did not pass Madhyamik or equivalent are also considered; Candidates with higher qualification may apply; only Madhyamik or equivalent marks are considered Age limit: Between 30 and 40 years for general candidates; between 22 and 40 years for SC and ST candidates (as on 25 November 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST Age limit 22 to 40 years as on 25-11-2026 Other conditions: Only married, widowed or court-decree divorced women may apply Must be a permanent resident of the identified service area of the concerned village Residence proof: self-attested copies of Voter ID card and Ration card Grade-1 and Grade-2 SHG members, trained Dai and Link Workers get preference on submitting certificate In SC/ST majority villages, qualified SC/ST applicants get preference; if none found, general candidates may be selected Desirable: Grade-1 or Grade-2 Self Help Group member, trained Dai or Link Worker (preference)

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Block Development Officer, Canning-II Development Block Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Block Development Officer, Canning-II Development Block Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 26 vacancies for ASHA (Accredited Social Health Activist).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Block Development Officer, Canning-II Development Block Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-1 of this notice (page 3)) and send it to The Block Development Officer, Canning-II Development Block, Village: Paina, P.O.: J.S.Bad, P.S.: Jibantala, Dist.: South 24 Pgs., PIN: 743376, by speed post or registered post only, to reach by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 30 and 40 years for general candidates; between 22 and 40 years for SC and ST candidates (as on 25 November 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST Age limit 22 to 40 years as on 25-11-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Honorarium based as per Govt. norms.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Must have appeared in the Madhyamik or equivalent examination. Candidates who did not pass Madhyamik or equivalent are also considered. Higher-qualified candidates may apply, but only Madhyamik or equivalent marks are considered.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only married, widowed or court-decree divorced women may apply. Must be a permanent resident of the identified service area of the concerned village. Residence proof: self-attested copies of Voter ID card and Ration card. Grade-1 and Grade-2 SHG members, trained Dai and Link Workers get preference on submitting certificate.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Unmarried women. Candidates who are not permanent residents of the concerned service area. A candidate submitting more than one application: all her applications are cancelled.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview (date, time and place sent by post to eligible candidates). Interview letters giving date, time and place are sent by post to eligible candidates. Only Madhyamik or equivalent marks are considered, even for higher-qualified candidates. Originals of documents (a) to (f) must be shown on the interview day.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement is on a contractual basis.
